aiResearchSummary.text: Intersect ENT is researching self-expanding devices and methods for delivering implants to the body, as described in Self-expanding devices and methods therefor. They are also developing systems, devices, and methods for treating sinus conditions using implants with hubs and expandable legs, as detailed in Systems, devices, and method for treating a sinus condition. Additionally, they focus on drug-coated expandable devices for treating nose, ear, or throat diseases, and devices for paranasal sinus conditions.
